Stonebridge Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Sabra Health Care Reit Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.52 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.87% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $19.75. About 560,985 shares traded. Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (NASDAQ:SBRA) has declined 38.98% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 50.53% the S&P500.
Dock Street Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 2.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
